newsitem.title: FRANCE: KLM decides on east France sub-hub by end-June/Jul.
newsitem.headline: KLM decides on east France sub-hub by end-June/Jul.

text.p: KLM said it would probably decide on the location of its proposed sub-hub in eastern France by the end of the month or early July.
"We expect to make our choice in the next few weeks and until then will not be making a statement on the sub-hub project," the spokesman added.
An Amsterdam-based spokesman for the Dutch airline told Reuters four, French airport sites had been under consideration - Lyon-Satolas, Dijon, Basle-Mulhouse and Strasbourg.

However, he said was unable to comment on reports from air cargo sources that KLM had already chosen Lyon as the location for the hub. The hub will provide freighter and trucking links with the airline's main hub at Amsterdam-Schiphol airport. -- Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+5017
